findings.label: Hardcoded fallback pin map
findings.detail: _PIN_FALLBACK embeds pygments pins for three tasks as a last resort when poetry.lock can't be parsed. It never fired this run (all four golds used lockfile provenance) and a fallback hit is recorded with a warning + provenance=fallback (build_kb.py tags pins=FALLBACK), so it cannot fake green silently. Consider dropping it or converting a fallback hit to INFRA so the engine can only ever pin from a task's real lock.

findings.label: Key evidence lives in prose
findings.detail: The base-env pip-freeze before/after comparison and gold exit/pass/fail numbers are reported in build_verification.md, not emitted as a committed artifact under kb/replays/. gold/<task>.json and clone_state.json cover provenance, pins, and module-file checks; a persisted freeze-diff would make the base-env claim independently re-checkable without re-running.
